ERA5_Land.Product_README: Validate this data with the gridded geodata in the zip file

CRUTS.Product_README: Validate this data with the gridded geodata in the zip file

NWM.Product_README: Validate this data with the point file labeled 'NWM' in the output folder

DAHITI.Product_README: Water surface elevation from DAHITI satellite altimetry. Requires DAHITI_API_KEY env var — register at https://dahiti.dgfi.tum.de/en/

GloFAS.Product_README: River discharge from GloFAS v4 ERA5-based reanalysis via CDS API. Uses the same credentials as ERA5-Land (~/.cdsapirc). Requires cfgrib: conda install -c conda-forge cfgrib

GLEAM.Product_README: Actual lake evaporation from GLEAM v3. Download Ew_* or Ea_* NetCDF files from https://www.gleam.eu (free registration) and place in GLHE/CLAY/LocalData/GLEAM/
